# TASK-024 Invoice numbers

Status: blocked

Outcome: invoices are numbered the way the ruling cited below says. Summary from the planning agent: invoice numbers carry the shop's prefix, for example SHOP-0001.

## Ruling reference

Handed over by the planning agent.

Reference
  Binding        billing
  Repository     example/mira-billing
  ADR            0005
  Path           docs/adr/0005-invoice-numbering.md
  Commit         3f1c9b7a2d4e8f605a1b3c7d9e0f2a4b6c8d1e3f
  Digest         sha256:5d41402abc4b2a76b9719d911017c5925d41402abc4b2a76b9719d911017c592

## Assessment — 2026-10-22

Decision: stop. Do not build the invoice numbering from the planning summary
until the cited ruling can be read and verified.

The reference identifies billing / example/mira-billing ADR 0005, not either
local repository's ADR 0005. The workspace contains example/mira-app at
dda0e11103a43f9b8a8b23cde52408f1eea6a626 and example/mira-decisions at
1b9d588d594609270cd28d48306fe6ae0926b26c, but no mira-billing clone. Neither
local repository contains the cited commit. The local ADRs numbered 0005
concern kiosk rebuilds and bank-transfer payments respectively; neither
establishes an invoice numbering rule.

GitHub requests for example/mira-billing and the exact cited file at the
cited commit both returned 404 (Not Found). This does not establish whether
the repository is absent or inaccessible. No bytes of the invoice ruling
were read, so no read commit or computed digest is available. The cited
digest is unverified, and whether the ruling is in force is unknown.

To resume, make the billing repository and cited revision accessible, read
docs/adr/0005-invoice-numbering.md at the full cited commit, compute SHA-256
over its exact bytes, compare it with the reference above, and check the
current decision history for amendments or supersession. Resolve any
discrepancy with the SHOP-0001 planning summary before changing readiness.

This assessment records a blocker, not a new business ruling. The requested
work is a decision only: no feature implementation, commits, pushes, or
merges are authorized by this task assessment.
